experimental_method: Liquid water sampled through a microfilter from a crystallizer with CH4 hydrate (or hydrate-free Lw-V), flashed in an evacuated bomb and the evolved CH4 measured in a Ruska gasometer, corrected for CH4 left dissolved at room conditions.
uncertainties_stated: Gasometer volume +-0.2% of reading; the flash method has a relative error of 5-9% of the calculated solubility (authors).
quality_remarks: Authors state hydrate formation reverses the temperature trend of solubility; pressure effect weak. Journal volume year 2002 (web 2001). The title page chunk metadata lists author as Servio alone; paper has Servio and Englezos.
not_extracted_tables: Table 2: comparison of Table 1 xeq (rounded to 5 decimals) with values calculated from the Englezos et al. assumption; derived/model values
extraction_notes: Text layer matched the image in every cell. T not monotonic across the table (grouped by pressure). No duplicates.
needs_pass2_reason: clean text layer, every cell matched the image
